item.title: WATCH: Former Israeli general outlines three possible war scenarios with Iran
item.description: Retired IDF General Amir Avivi outlined three potential war scenarios with Iran: a large-scale Iranian missile strike, an Israeli preemptive attack, or a U.S.-led intervention to topple the regime—the last viewed as the most stabilizing outcome. The post WATCH: Former Israeli general outlines three possible war scenarios with Iran appeared first on World Israel News.
